briefs.task: Plan module SHOWCASE (row 13 in docs/plans/ARCHITECTURE.md: the V1 exit, the showcase valley on Mac and in Chrome, reviewed, with its closing record). It needs: The last milestone of modules 1 to 10 and 12.

Two tasks in one pass.
1) Dependency audit. The owner (14 Nov 2026) says development is far behind pace: Codex quota use is about 5% a day against a target near 15%, because only 4 milestones can start at once. Go through every milestone dependency in docs/plans/*/PLAN.md and DONE.json, and remove each edge that only sets an order, keeping only those where a milestone needs another milestone's actual output (code, interface, data or a verified baseline it builds on). Where a milestone needs only part of another, depend on the earliest milestone that provides that part. Owner decision: keep the swarm-game modules (SIM-2D, SWARM, TRANSPORT, RENDER-2D, GAME-UI, SESSION) gated on SHOWCASE:M8 as they are now. Contention for the shared GPU lock and disk is not a reason for an edge; the script queues GPU work. List each edge you removed or kept with a one-line reason in the evidence folder, and say how many milestones can start once the running ones finish.
2) ATMOSPHERE's latest design review (docs/evidence/ATMOSPHERE/design-review.md) found 1 Must Fix after the horizon-haze re-plan. Resolve it, keeping SCENE-VIEWS, WATERS and CLOUDS consistent.

Two tasks in one pass.
1) Owner decision, 14 Nov 2026: "Let's move the 2d engine side of things to before v1 and decouple them. But we don't want to start working on the swarm game till v1 lands." Split the swarm-goal modules (SIM-2D, RENDER-2D, TRANSPORT, GAME-UI, SESSION, SWARM and any others from docs/design/NEXT-GOAL-SWARM-GAME.md) into reusable 2D engine work and swarm-game work. Engine work loses its gate on SHOWCASE:M8 and keeps only edges where it needs another milestone's actual output; where an engine milestone is shaped by the swarm game, state its requirement generically so the engine does not depend on game code. Game work (SWARM and any game-specific milestones) stays gated on SHOWCASE:M8. Where a module mixes both, move the game milestones into the game module rather than gating engine ones. Engine designs that change need their design reviews.
2) APPLE-PRESENTATION M4 to M11 have no done-when entries, so no builder can be given them, and SHOWCASE M7-M8 (the V1 exit) sit behind them (docs/evidence/dependency-audit-2026-11-14/README.md). Write their done-when items and plans so they can be built, with honest dependencies. Do not change APPLE-PRESENTATION M3, which a builder holds.
Say which milestones can start once this lands.
